cases.name: local-store-through-with
cases.derivation: A class attribute store remains class-local, even under a module with statement; direct module function selection is unchanged.

cases.name: local-delete-through-for
cases.derivation: A function-local delete cannot remove a module class without modeled global execution; no fixture is executed.

cases.name: local-function-under-match
cases.source:
async def chosen():
    return 5
match value:
    case 0:
        class Holder:
            def chosen(self):
                pass
cases.derivation: A method declaration is not module competition; wildcard pattern capture is deliberately absent.

cases.name: local-class-under-finally
cases.derivation: The nested class name is bound inside wrapper, whereas wrapper itself is a distinct module name.

cases.name: unicode-crlf-local-annotation
cases.derivation: Unicode local annotations do not rebind a module function; physical-line and snapshot/resource provenance must remain exact.

cases.name: absent-name-local-only
cases.derivation: A class-only name cannot manufacture even a non-declaration module binding.

cases.name: real-with-target
cases.source:
def chosen():
    pass
with manager as chosen:
    pass
cases.derivation: A module with target really does compete with the direct declaration.

cases.name: mapping-rest-capture
cases.source:
class Selected:
    pass
match payload:
    case {**Selected}:
        pass
cases.derivation: The mapping-rest string name is an actual module capture, distinct from import/name-store paths.

cases.name: guarded-handler-alias
cases.derivation: Handler alias lifetime is not interpreted; genuine module alias competition stays conservative.

cases.name: decorated-direct-remains-unsupported
cases.derivation: Local attribute isolation does not promote an unsupported decorated direct declaration.

cases.name: unrelated-local-renaming
cases.derivation: An imported alias remains a non-declaration with or without a same-spelled class-local store.

cases.name: dynamic-local-policy-preserved
cases.derivation: Existing conservative dynamic-call policy is a separate gate, not weakened by namespace traversal changes.

independence: Freshly authored before new inference. Non-import stores/deletes/declarations, Unicode/CRLF provenance and distinct conservative controls. No previous private implementation or reference patch is supplied to the model.
